verdicts.reading: App marketplaces for educational software, used by schools and teachers, are already in use around 2012 (first-row placement = already here). Test: at least 5% of schools acquiring apps through an education store or education purchasing channel by 2014.
verdicts.reason: Apple's Volume Purchase Program for Education (US 2010) is an education-only storefront through which schools buy and distribute App Store apps, and iTunes U is an education-only content store; with 4.5M iPads in US schools by Feb 2013, well over 5% of US schools used that channel by 2014. B required a store that is education-dedicated in its catalogue and found no share figure; the VPP education store meets the label's sense. Google Play for Education closing in 2016 is after Y+2 and does not undo the hit.

evidence.title: Apple Has Sold Over 8M iPads Direct To Education Worldwide, With More Than 1B iTunes U Downloads
evidence.shows: 8M iPads sold direct to education (4.5M US); iTunes U over 1B downloads

evidence.title: Apple offers volume educational discounts for App Store purchases
evidence.shows: Education-specific app purchasing program for US schools launched 2010

evidence.title: Google Play For Education Is Going Away
evidence.shows: A second dedicated education store ran 2013-2016

verdicts.reading: E-ink e-readers are already used for school reading around 2012. Test: at least 5% of schools or school libraries using them by 2014.
verdicts.reason: The LJ/SLJ ebook survey found 6% of school libraries circulating preloaded e-reading devices, and among those the devices were mostly e-ink (Sony Reader 64%, Kindle 47%, Nook 15%, iPad 4%). That crosses D37's 5% bar by Y+2, narrowly. B's evidence measures student interest in e-books, not the share of schools using e-readers, so it does not test the threshold.

evidence.title: Ebooks Take Hold in Schools - Slowly (SLJ)
evidence.shows: 6% of school libraries circulate preloaded e-reading devices; 36% considering; devices mostly Sony Reader and Kindle (via search snippet; page returned 403)

verdicts.reading: Cameras or sensors that track where a student is looking are used in learning environments around 2022. Test: at least 5% of institutions using gaze tracking in learning or assessment by 2024.
verdicts.reason: A's hit counts remote proctoring as eye tracking. Proctorio, the leading tool, states it does not track eye movements; it flags face presence and head turning away. So the 54% proctoring share measures webcam face monitoring, not eye tracking. True eye tracking in learning stayed in research and pilots, with some gaze-estimation features in proctoring. Real use below 5% = partial.

evidence.title: Proctorio: Frequently asked questions
evidence.shows: Proctorio does not track eye movements; uses face detection to check whether the test-taker looks away

evidence.title: Proctoring Software in Higher Ed: Prevalence and Patterns (EDUCAUSE Review)
evidence.shows: 54% of institutions used remote proctoring in 2020, i.e. webcam monitoring, not necessarily eye tracking

evidence.title: AI-assisted Gaze Detection for Proctoring Online Exams
evidence.shows: Gaze detection for proctoring still presented as a research contribution in 2024

verdicts.reading: Computing and sensing embedded in everyday classroom objects (internet of things) influences learning environments around 2022. Test: at least 5% of schools using intelligent, networked classroom objects by 2024.
verdicts.reason: A's two cases do not meet the reading: England's CO2 monitors are single-purpose building sensors with no intelligence, and the micro:bit is a programmable board taught as a computer, not intelligence embedded in everyday objects. Both show real adjacent use; no measure puts smart classroom objects at 5% of schools. Real but limited = partial.

evidence.title: CO2 monitors: cumulative delivery statistics (DfE)
evidence.shows: 329,231 CO2 monitors delivered to English state schools: simple sensors, not intelligent objects

evidence.title: Micro Bit
evidence.shows: About 1M micro:bit boards given to UK Year 7 pupils from 2016
